<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_snc_aegis.AEGISJDArchitect</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AEGISJDArchitect</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AEGISJDArchitect = Class.create();
AEGISJDArchitect.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    BIASED_TERMS: [
        'rockstar', 'ninja', 'guru', 'wizard',
        'young and energetic', 'digital native',
        'culture fit', 'dominant', 'aggressive',
        'work hard play hard', 'manpower', 'fresh graduate only'
    ],

    /**
     * Scans text for biased or exclusionary terms.
     */
    checkBiasedLanguage: function(text) {
        if (!text) return { hasBias: false, flaggedTerms: [] };

        var lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
        var flagged = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < this.BIASED_TERMS.length; i++) {
            var term = this.BIASED_TERMS[i];
            if (lowerText.indexOf(term) !== -1) {
                flagged.push(term);
            }
        }

        return {
            hasBias: flagged.length > 0,
            flaggedTerms: flagged
        };
    },

    /**
     * Builds structured prompt for GenAI or template fallback.
     */
    buildJDPrompt: function(roleTitle, level, department, requiredSkills, niceToHave, offerings) {
        return 'Generate an inclusive, professional job description for:\n' +
            'Role: ' + roleTitle + '\n' +
            'Level: ' + level + '\n' +
            'Department: ' + department + '\n' +
            'Required Skills: ' + requiredSkills + '\n' +
            'Nice to Have: ' + (niceToHave || 'None') + '\n' +
            'Company Offerings: ' + (offerings || 'Standard competitive compensation, growth, and benefits') + '\n\n' +
            'Guidelines:\n' +
            '- Use gender-neutral, inclusive language\n' +
            '- Avoid buzzwords (ninja, rockstar, guru)\n' +
            '- Include: Role Summary, Key Responsibilities, Requirements, Nice to Have, What We Offer\n' +
            '- Focus on competencies, not credentials';
    },

    /**
     * Saves a job description draft with automated bias checking.
     */
    saveJD: function(requisitionSysId, jdText, createdByUserId) {
        var biasCheck = this.checkBiasedLanguage(jdText);

        var ver = 1;
        var existing = new GlideRecord('x_snc_aegis_job_description');
        existing.addQuery('requisition', requisitionSysId);
        existing.orderByDesc('version');
        existing.setLimit(1);
        existing.query();
        if (existing.next()) {
            ver = (parseInt(existing.getValue('version')) || 1) + 1;
        }

        var jd = new GlideRecord('x_snc_aegis_job_description');
        jd.initialize();
        jd.setValue('requisition', requisitionSysId);
        jd.setValue('jd_text', jdText);
        jd.setValue('version', ver);
        jd.setValue('bias_check_passed', !biasCheck.hasBias);
        jd.setValue('flagged_terms', biasCheck.flaggedTerms.join(', '));
        jd.setValue('approval_state', 'DRAFT');

        if (createdByUserId) {
            jd.setValue('created_by', createdByUserId);
        }

        var sysId = jd.insert();
        if (!sysId) {
            gs.info('[AEGIS] FAILED to save JD: ' + jd.getLastErrorMessage());
            return null;
        }

        gs.info('[AEGIS] JD saved: ' + sysId + ' v' + ver +
            ' (bias check: ' + (biasCheck.hasBias ? 'FLAGGED [' + biasCheck.flaggedTerms.join(', ') + ']' : 'PASSED') + ')');

        return sysId;
    },

    type: 'AEGISJDArchitect'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 11:04:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>f84767bf6d5f03107f44d98064d89784</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGISJDArchitect</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f84767bf6d5f03107f44d98064d89784</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 14:38:17</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
